name: Vaelastrasz the Corrupt
source: [core: vmangos] Melee 3,844 to 5,096 a 2.0 s swing before armor: vmangos core (github.com/vmangos/core, db_latest db-4641790): creature_template, spell_template, the boss script, damage_multiplier 35. Burning Adrenaline 23620 on the tank every 45 s (it dies 20 s later), so tanks swap every 45 s. Flame Breath 23461 3,500 to 4,500 Fire every 5 to 10 s, frontal, and 938 to 1,062 Fire every 3 s for 15 s, stacking to 5. Cleave 19983 every 5 to 10 s. Fire Nova 23462 555 to 645 Fire to the raid every 2 s.
notes: One tank's 45 s stint, so the fight is 45 s. Flame Breath's DoT is modelled as one stack's worth per breath (5 ticks of 1,000), not the stacking. Fire resistance takes its share of the Fire. The Burning Adrenaline on casters and the raid's Fire Nova on others are the healing sim's.

healing.notes: A 40-player Blackwing Lair raid's main tank: 4 healers at 500 HPS each in 2 s heals, more healing power than in Molten Core (about 600). Guessed, not from logs: replace with tools/warcraftlogs tank numbers.
